content: Kyekà, le kiin a indiir itɛɛnà bi alà: Bi ibye anà undweer a angaŋ a tub awà, nde mbuur kàkàbwaay u kɔɔ ibaal a kir a imwol a làkoo a Nzam.
Nde wàmukyer ingaŋ ande kà idwà anà ntɛn a ndandaa kàkyer Mwol, wɛɛ mpa kàkyer mbuur.
Undweer a angaŋ bàfun'sà ntɔn mupà an'kab anà ibɔɔn akà Nzam. Abun, yà ndöŋ naa nde sye ukäl anà undiir mwɛy mupà.
Kya nde kàlàkal u mɛɛn, nde kàlàkal anki itàkal ngaŋ, ntɔn angaŋ bà paa, ba bàfàpà an'kab mulab nswɛɛŋ a Un'kɔɔn.

Wɛɛ ba, ingaŋ aba bàfàkyer uboo a idwà akyà ikwom, munii a idwà a ndandaa akyà u du, asànaa nswɛɛŋ a Nzam kàwɛl Mɔsɛ ntɔn mutɔŋ ntɛn a nköŋ: « Indiir byanswà ngye ayàkyer asànaa baswɛŋ bya u du a mɔŋ. »
Wɛɛ apanà, Yɛsu kan'wal isal aŋàsöön ubwaŋ, ntɔn nde wà mfurbo a nkwà aŋàsöön ubwaŋ, yan'bwaay udu a ilää aŋàsöön ubwaŋ.
Ntɔn, yàlàkal naa nkwà atàtwɛb yàkäl anki anà an'pɛl, ndöŋ yàlàkal anki mukiir yàyweel.
Kyekà, muswaŋ naa nkwà atàtwɛb ye anà an'pɛl, Nzam atɛɛnà a un'sɛŋ ande naa:

content.text: anà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl anà wà Yudà.
« Wɛɛ, ya isàkal anki asànaa nkwà kàdi mɛ anà ankaa aba
mpal katɛ mɛ mpi u kɔɔ ntɔn mukatwey u Ngipiti.
Ntɔn ba ŋakwo bàläm anki uboo a nkwà amɛ,
« Ntɔn, le nkwà in'sàdyà mɛ anà un'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl
mɛ in'sàsà in'kɔɔn amɛ unsà an'kyän aba,
mɛ in'sàsɔn mya u mpem aba:
Mɛ in'sàkal Nzam aba, ba bàsàkal un'sɛŋ amɛ.
Akà mbuur mwɛy usàkal anki anà ndöŋ mukyään mbääb ande itàkal un'tɔŋ ande
Ntɔn baar banswà bàkyer asan'yöb, sɛmà umbɛy tii akà undweer.
Ntɔn mɛ in'sàdwa nkul a ibii aba, mɛ in'fàsàyɔbà anki man'be aba. »

content: Abun, Mwol kàbel nde nkwà ayi naa nkwà akün, iswaŋà naa yàtàtwɛb nde kàbuul undiir itaan. Kyekà, undiir usàbulà wà itaan anà usànün, wa wà tsütsü muyaalà.
